basis_statement: Canonical time helpers normalize instants to UTC, keep business dates calendar-safe, and separate human display formatting from replay and hash truth.

source_lineage.rationale: Replay-safe emission requires explicit timezone handling and canonical UTC output.

source_lineage.source_heading_or_logical_block: canonical time handling within deterministic outcome payloads
source_lineage.rationale: Instant normalization must happen before hashes or replay evidence are emitted.
Cross-runtime duration math assumes UTC-normalized instants.

business_date_examples.label: Business date remains a plain calendar day

display_example.note: Display helpers remain explicitly locale- and zone-bound so canonical storage output never depends on ambient machine settings.

forbidden_cases.label: Missing timezone
forbidden_cases.reason: Canonical instants must include Z or an explicit offset.

forbidden_cases.label: Malformed tax year
forbidden_cases.reason: Tax year labels must advance by exactly one year.
